Name: Achzib
ModernLocation: Unknown; two towns share the name, one in Judah's lowland and one on Asher's coast
Description: The name belongs to two towns: one in Judah's lowland and one on Asher's coast, which Asher failed to take. Both appear only in the allotment and conquest lists, and neither site is identified.
BiblicalSignificance: Achzib is shared by a Judah town and an Asher coastal town left untaken.
